factory-complete-client.command: FACTORY_JOURNEYS="${FACTORY_JOURNEYS:-connected_setup motion_setting fork_run horizontal_connect return_multiselect form_layout_review viewport_keyboard parallel_authoring quick_open_after_edit responsive_review}" KARABINER_CLIENT_BIN="$PWD/target/agent/debug/karabiner" zsh .groundwork/scripts/factory-complete-client.sh
factory-complete-client.expect: The selected native journeys assert named mappings and explicit push retry/effects, running-state motion, branch/attempt history, rendered horizontal defaults and a right-output/left-input connection, return multiselect save/reopen/clear, form-label visibility and section headers, editor history/clipboard/keyboard/viewport behavior, saved-revision validation and Quick Open. Only recorded assertions count; grouping, clipping, handles and normal/narrow usability require actual Opus visual review.

context.journeySelection: Caller FACTORY_JOURNEYS override; otherwise the documented ten-journey default. Actual coverage is limited to recorded observations.

factory-builder.expect: The native fixture drives real graph edits, revision/draft handling, task questions/approval and output UI, retaining state assertions and actual native/canonical React Flow captures for review

factory-builder-tail.expect: The focused native tail captures and asserts Save/Validate settling, correctly targeted dragging during live updates and narrow panel allocation; it does not replay or claim the full factory journey

factory-visual-review.expect: An actual Opus post-capture review records claim-specific observations against retained native/React Flow evidence, preserving capture hashes without claiming another UI execution
